contract: GMLI China M2 official-source candidate v2
purpose: Replace the opaque legacy China stitch prospectively with a reproducible PBoC-native M2 level history while preserving the existing GMLI seven-region architecture and evaluating the impact before any Core promotion.

methodology_policy.candidate_rule: Treat this as a new versioned production-source candidate. Compare it with the legacy benchmark; do not call it the missing historical exact rerun.
preferred_source_order: PBoC annual Money Supply table with monthly M2 levels
PBoC monthly Financial Statistics Report for gaps/current year

annual_tables.note: PBoC retrospectively updated 2017 M2 for the January 2018 money-market-fund statistical-method change; use the comparable revised levels in this official table.
PBoC notes the December 2022 e-CNY M0 change does not materially change M1/M2 growth rates.

This preserved official table currently contains Jan-Oct 2025; later months are filled only from official monthly Financial Statistics Reports. The 2025 M1 definition change is not an M2 definition change.

report_fill_ranges.reason: Annual Report exposes quarter-end M2, while monthly Financial Statistics Reports provide all monthly balances.
Use official monthly reports across the 2018 statistical-method transition; 2017 comparable revised levels come from the official 2017 table.
Use official monthly reports unless a simpler full-year Money Supply table is validated later.
Current/forward extension from official monthly reports; stop automatically at the latest report that exists.

known_breaks.description: PBoC improved the money-market-fund component of money supply statistics and retrospectively revised 2017 M2 for comparability.
e-CNY was added to M0; PBoC states revised M1/M2 growth rates were not materially changed.
PBoC revised M1 definition; this contract uses M2 and records the break for provenance only.

promotion_policy: A complete official V2 series may be used to construct a new Money candidate and rerun the locked transmission evaluation. Promotion, if justified, is a new version decision and does not alter the historical fact that the old v1.8b exact rerun was impossible.
